# Re-Charge

> Re-Charge is an AI and automation studio in Johannesburg, South Africa, working with businesses anywhere. It builds AI that drafts, sorts and follows up on a business's repetitive work (customer emails, missed calls, quotes, invoices, enquiries and documents) from the business's own information, with a person checking every result. The place to start is the Inbox Assistant: routine customer emails drafted from your own prices and policies, from R2,950 a month.

Key facts:
- Location: Johannesburg, South Africa. Works with businesses across South Africa and abroad (quotes in ZAR, USD, EUR or GBP).
- Who it's for: offices, practices and service businesses with repetitive admin, especially teams handling 20 or more customer emails a day (accounting and professional firms, practices, trades, salons, restaurants, cleaning services).
- How it works: a free 30-minute call; then the work is measured, a small version is proven on real work, and the full version is built and connected to the tools the business already uses. A person stays in charge: nothing is sent without someone checking it.
- Privacy: handled under South Africa's POPIA. Client data is never used to train AI. The Inbox Assistant's drafts are written by an AI model running on Re-Charge's own computer in South Africa.
- Prices are in rand, fixed before work starts, and no VAT is added (Re-Charge is not VAT-registered).
- Contact: phone and WhatsApp +27 72 237 5833. Book a free 30-minute call: https://calendar.app.google/58FYamh1ahXB4khM9

## The Inbox Assistant (the place to start)

- What it does: drafts replies to a business's routine customer emails from its own prices, policies and way of replying, and marks anything it isn't sure of for a person to fill in. The team checks and sends each reply.
- Works with any inbox (Gmail, Outlook or anything else) through a private web page: paste an email in, copy the reply out. On Microsoft 365 the drafts can wait in the inbox instead. It also summarises long email threads.
- Price: R9,500 setup and R2,950 a month for the whole business, AI usage included (up to 1,500 emails a month). Ready within 3 business days.
- Trial: a R1,500 deposit starts a two-week trial on real emails, measured from how each draft was used. The rest is paid only if it saves the team 5 hours a week; otherwise the deposit is refunded in full within 7 days. If kept: a 3-month minimum, then month to month.
- Page: [Inbox Assistant](https://re-charge.co.za/inbox-assistant)

## Other work and prices

- Custom AI that reads and replies (WhatsApp and enquiry assistants, documents read and captured, answers from a business's own documents): from R25,000.
- An automation (one task the team types by hand, done for them): from R15,000.
- A dashboard (the business's numbers on one screen, always up to date): from R15,000.
- Connecting systems so nothing is typed in twice: from R45,000.
- A business website: from R12,500; with bookings or payments: from R35,000.
- Bigger processes, in stages: Find (measuring the work, 1–2 weeks) R15,000, credited if the project goes ahead; Prove (a small version on real work, 2–4 weeks) from R35,000; Build (the full version, connected and the team trained) from R85,000. A typical total is about R120,000, and the client can stop after any stage.
- Keeping AI systems running: Operate R7,500 a month (one system), Optimise R15,000 a month (up to three), Partner R35,000 a month (all systems, priority replies). Website hosting R450 a month; Care (hosting and an hour of changes) R1,450 a month.
